class.name: VoxelModifierPath
class.brief_description: Voxel modifier that sweeps a rounded box along a polyline.
class.description: Its cross-section spans [member width] across the path, and from [member bottom] to [member top] along its up (Y, kept level whatever the path's slope), with edges rounded by [member rounding]. Useful for a road's bed, a trench or a tunnel.

members.member: Bottom of the cross-section, relative to the path.
The path, in the modifier's local space.
Radius the cross-section's edges are rounded by.
Top of the cross-section, relative to the path.
